IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:

Winds: Variable about 10 knots becoming south to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots in the late afternoon then tending west to southwesterly in the late evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy. 90% chance of showers.

Thursday 5 November
Winds: Southwesterly 10 to 15 knots tending south to southeasterly in the middle of the day then tending northwesterly in the early afternoon.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Mostly sunny.

Friday 6 November
Winds: North to northwesterly 10 to 15 knots turning westerly during the morning.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy. 70% chance of showers.

Saturday 7 November
Winds: Westerly 10 to 15 knots tending southwesterly 15 to 25 knots during the morning.
Seas: Below 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 2 metres during the afternoon.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 70% chance of showers.
IDT12420.synoptic: A cold front is expected to move across Tasmania from the west today, with a ridge developing from a high over the mainland on Thursday. A more significant cold front is forecast to move over from the west during the day on Friday, followed by a cold southwesterly wind flow on Saturday.

IDT12326.name: South East Coast
IDT12326.text:
Wednesday 4 November
Winds: Northwest to northeasterly 10 to 15 knots tending northwest to southwesterly in the late afternoon then becoming southwesterly 15 to 20 knots in the evening.
Seas: Around 1 metre.
Swell: Southwesterly 1.5 to 2.5 metres.
Weather: Cloudy. 90% chance of showers.

Thursday 5 November
Winds: Southwesterly 15 to 20 knots turning northwesterly 15 to 25 knots in the afternoon. Winds reaching up to 30 knots offshore during the afternoon and evening.
Seas: 1.5 to 2.5 metres.
Swell: Southwesterly 1.5 to 2.5 metres.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Friday 6 November
Winds: Northwesterly 20 to 30 knots turning westerly during the morning.
Seas: 1.5 to 2.5 metres.
Swell: West to southwesterly 2.5 to 3 metres, increasing to 3 to 4 metres during the morning.
Weather: Cloudy. 90% chance of showers, with possible small hail in the afternoon and evening.
